title: 第13章 交换条件第14章 比尔森
lines: 江来失笑道：“海先生，我没听错吧，我跟你另外一个女儿的账都没算清，你居然请我保护你现在的女儿，这种非分的要求你觉得我会答应吗？”
“我相信你会。”海重安自信满满的说道：“如果没有把握，我也不会亲自跑来找你了。”
江来沉吟了片刻，道：“你们海家底蕴雄厚，有钱有势，完全可以去请别人，为什么要找上我？”
“因为我相信，这个世界上没有任何人比圣殿的国王陛下更适合，只要你出手，我就能高枕无忧了。”
听到这话，江来不由笑了，“我猜得没错，你果然做足了准备，连我的身份都一清二楚。我很想知道，是谁告诉你的？卿曼容？还是你的老婆？”
海重安避重就轻道：“江先生，只要你帮流沙度过危机，作为报答，我会告诉你有关卿曼容的线索。怎么样？”
“好！”江来想都没想，一口应了下来。当海重安道出他身份的那一刻起，他就放弃了别的想法。既然对方知道他是谁，还敢找上门来提条件，想必是有十足的把握。如果他没猜错，在海重安的背后必定有人指点，那个人很可能就是卿曼容。
见他毫不犹豫的应允，海重安嘴角一扬，整个人都放松了下来。
“江先生，我想提醒你一下，流沙并不清楚她母亲和她姐姐的具体情况，为了不让她忧心，我暂时还不打算告诉她实情。另外，我和你达成的协议更不能透露半句让她知道。因为昨晚的事情，她对你怨念很深，所以，你必须自己想办法博取她的认可。”
“小意思，我会搞定。”江来表现的很轻松。不过，他心里却暗暗叫苦，由于昨晚把海流沙误认成是卿曼容，所以他对海流沙做了很多过分的举动，换做任何一个女人，都不会轻易原谅他的行为。原以为二人不会再有交集，所以他并不在乎，但现在……唉！真是件让人头疼的事情。
从江来的家里出来，海重安坐上自己的座驾，然后拿出手机，拨通了一个牢记在心的号码。
“喂！是我，他答应了……希望你这么做不是在玩火，像他这种人可不是那么好驾驭的。”
在家休息一上午，吃过中饭后，江来走出家门，在路边拦了一辆计程车，径直往南月集团赶去。海重安在临走前告诉他，海流沙今天会去公司，如果想找她的话，只能去南月集团。
二十多分钟后，计程车抵达了目的地。
江来走下车，整了整衣衫，然后举步往集团内部走去。作为世界五百强企业的总部，南月集团的装修非常豪华，宽敞的大厅铺着大理石地板，金线镶嵌，顶端天花板悬挂着几盏琉璃水晶灯，一旁的休息区摆放着苹果电脑和皮质沙发，角落里还设有专门的吸烟区。
来到前台，看着长相标致甜美的接待人员，江来开门见山道：“我找你们董事长。”
“先生，您好，请问您有预约吗？”
“我……算了！”江来转念一想，万一海流沙知道是他，打电话报警怎么办？他可不想惹来不必要的麻烦。
此刻正好是中午时分，不少员工在外购买午餐。他在大厅里晃悠了一圈，等员工刷卡进电梯的时候，他跟着混了进去，反正人多，没人知道他是谁。
叮！
随着电梯门缓缓开启，江来缓步走出，看了眼周围的环境，然后沿着走廊往里走去。顶楼是董事长的专用楼层，除了董事长办公室和休息室外，还有单独的健身房，娱乐室，贵宾接待室，可谓一应俱全。
在董事长办公室外，有一个小隔间，里面摆放着一张办公桌，那应该是董事长秘书的位置，只不过，现在没看到人，可能是去吃午饭了。
“咚咚咚！”
伴随敲门声响起，江来听着办公室内的动静，却始终没有回应。见状，他又敲了一次门，但还是无人答话。
“没人吗？”他喃喃自语，然后推门走了进去。
宽敞亮堂的办公室中，三面都是巨大的落地玻璃窗，举目远眺，可以看到不少QZ市的地标性建筑，视野非常开阔，感觉像是置身钢铁丛林，令人心生震撼。
正想着，一阵细微的声音突然传入耳中，江来转头看去，只见办公室的墙壁有一道隐藏的门。乍看之下，还以为是一幅挂在墙上的现代画，若非声音暴露了它的位置，别人很难察觉。当下，他走到近前，发现里面传来哗啦啦的水声，似乎有人在沐浴。
“难怪敲门没反应，原来是在这里面。”他耸耸肩，自顾自的在沙发落座，然后掏出一根香烟，在办公室中吞云吐雾起来。
十多分钟后，‘吱呀’一声，那道隐藏的门缓缓打开，穿着一身白色职业套装的海流沙款步走出，也许是刚沐浴过的缘故，她身上散发的清香非常浓郁，有种兰花草的味道。
闻着办公室中刺鼻的烟味，海流沙柳眉微蹙，美眸定睛看去，透过缭绕的烟雾，一张让她深感痛恶的脸庞立刻出现在她的眼中。
“是你？”她微微一怔，随即怒容显现，轻喝道：“你怎么在这，谁让你进来的。”
江来笑着打了个招呼，道：“海小姐，又见面了。”
“你来得正好，既然来了，就别离开了。”说着，海流沙快步走到办公桌前，拿起桌面上的手机，就准备打电话报警。昨晚江来走后，她越想越不甘，自己何曾受过这种欺辱，要是再碰到他，一定让他好看。
一旁的云江见状，神色不变道：“海小姐，如果我是你，绝不会这样做，难道你想让昨晚的事情重演一遍？”
听到这话，海流沙的动作不由一僵，眼中羞怒交加。这个混蛋，竟然敢威胁自己！深吸了一口气，她稍作犹豫，然后将手机缓缓放下。一想到昨晚的经历，她的确有些忌惮，万一那家伙又对自己动手动脚，估计她连想死的心都有了。
平复了一下心情，她转过身，看着沙发上的江来，问道：“说吧，你来找我干什么？”
“海小姐，我听说你最近的情况不太妙，好像有人想对你不利。”
“这跟你有什么关系？你不觉得自己多管闲事了吗。”
“如果是以前，我不会在乎你的死活，但是，既然你跟卿曼容是双胞胎姐妹，那我就不能让你死了。只有你活着，我才有机会找到她。”
“你做梦！”海流沙冷冰冰的说道：“我绝不会把我的安全交到你这种人手中，还有，我警告你，你别打我姐姐的主意，你要敢动她一根汗毛，我绝不会放过你。”
“这可由不得你。”江来将烟头掐灭，慢慢起身走到海流沙的近前，看着她那张精美无暇的脸庞，皮笑肉不笑道：“海小姐，既然你这么维护你姐姐，不想她受到伤害，那你干脆代她受过好了。”
感受到他的不良居心，海流沙情不自禁的后退一步，唇齿轻启道：“你……什么意思？”
“你姐姐不仅是我的仇人，也是我的女人。如果你不想她有事，那就代替她做我的女人，伺候我，接受我的报复，你，愿意吗？”
content_en:
Jiang Laishi laughed and said: "Mr. Hai, did I hear you right? I haven't even settled the accounts with your other daughter yet, and you actually asked me to protect your current daughter. Do you think I will agree to such an unreasonable request?"
"I believe you will." Hai Chong'an said confidently: "If I wasn't sure, I wouldn't come to you personally."
Jiang Lai pondered for a moment and said: "Your Hai family has a strong foundation, wealth and power. You can definitely invite others. Why do you want to find me?"
"Because I believe that no one in this world is more suitable than His Majesty the King of the Temple. As long as you take action, I can rest easy."
Hearing this, Jiang Lai couldn't help but smile, "I guessed it right. You were really well prepared and even knew my identity. I really want to know, who told you? Qing Manrong? Or your wife?"
Hai Chongan avoided the important issue and said lightly: "Mr. Jiang, as long as you help Liusha survive the crisis, in return, I will tell you clues about Qing Manrong. How about it?"
"Okay!" Jiang Lai agreed without even thinking. The moment Hai Chongan revealed his identity, he gave up other ideas. Since the other party knows who he is and dares to come to him to make terms, he must be very confident. If he guessed correctly, there must be someone behind Hai Chongan's back, and that person was probably Qing Manrong.
Seeing that he agreed without hesitation, Hai Chongan raised the corner of his mouth and relaxed.
"Mr. Jiang, I would like to remind you that Liusha does not know the specific situation of her mother and her sister. In order to prevent her from worrying, I am not going to tell her the truth yet. In addition, I cannot reveal even half of the agreement I reached with you to let her know. Because of what happened last night, she has a deep resentment towards you, so you must find a way to win her approval yourself."
"No problem, I'll take care of it." Jiang Lai acted very relaxed. However, he was secretly complaining in his heart. Because he mistook Hai Liusha for Qing Manrong last night, he did many excessive things to Hai Liusha. No woman would easily forgive his behavior. He originally thought that the two of them would never meet again, so he didn't care, but now... Alas! What a headache.
After coming out of Jiang Lai's home, Hai Chongan got into his car, then took out his mobile phone and dialed a number that he remembered well.
"Hey! It's me, he agreed... I hope you're not playing with fire by doing this. People like him are not that easy to control."
…
After resting at home all morning and having lunch, Jiang Lai walked out of the house, hailed a taxi on the side of the road, and went straight to Nanyue Group. Before leaving, Hai Chongan told him that Hai Liusha would go to the company today, and if he wanted to find her, he could only go to Nanyue Group.
More than twenty minutes later, the taxi arrived at its destination.
Jiang Lai got out of the car, straightened his clothes, and then walked into the group. As the headquarters of one of the world's top 500 companies, Nanyue Group's decoration is very luxurious. The spacious hall is paved with marble floors and inlaid with gold threads. Several glass crystal lamps hang from the top ceiling. Apple computers and leather sofas are placed in the rest area on the side. There is also a special smoking area in the corner.
When he came to the front desk and looked at the handsome and sweet receptionist, Jiang Lai said straight to the point: "I'm looking for your chairman."
"Hello, sir, do you have an appointment?"
"I...forget it!" Jiang Lai then thought, what if Hai Liusha knew it was him and called the police? He didn't want to cause unnecessary trouble.
It was exactly noon at this moment, and many employees were out buying lunch. He wandered around in the lobby, and when the employees swiped their cards to enter the elevator, he followed him in. There were so many people, no one knew who he was.
bite!
As the elevator door slowly opened, Jiang Lai walked out slowly, looked at the surrounding environment, and then walked along the corridor. The top floor is the chairman's dedicated floor. In addition to the chairman's office and lounge, there is also a separate gym, entertainment room, and VIP reception room.
Outside the chairman's office, there is a small cubicle with a desk inside, which should be the position of the chairman's secretary. However, no one is seen now, maybe he has gone to have lunch.
"Dong dong dong!"
As the knock on the door rang, Jiang Lai listened to the movement in the office, but there was still no response. Seeing this, he knocked on the door again, but still no one answered.
"Is there no one there?" He muttered to himself, then opened the door and walked in.
In the spacious and bright office, there are huge floor-to-ceiling glass windows on three sides. Looking up, you can see many landmark buildings in QZ City. The view is very broad, and it feels like being in a steel jungle, which is shocking.
Just as he was thinking about it, a faint sound suddenly reached his ears. Jiang Lai turned around and saw a hidden door on the wall of the office. At first glance, one might have thought it was a modern painting hanging on the wall. Unless the sound revealed its location, it would be difficult for others to detect it. At that moment, he walked closer and found the sound of rushing water coming from inside, as if someone was taking a bath.
"No wonder there was no response when I knocked on the door. It turned out to be in here." He shrugged, sat down on the sofa, took out a cigarette, and started puffing away in the office.
More than ten minutes later, with a 'squeak' sound, the hidden door slowly opened, and Hai Liusha, wearing a white professional suit, stepped out. Perhaps it was because she had just taken a bath, the fragrance exuding from her body was very rich, with the smell of orchids.
Smelling the pungent smell of smoke in the office, Hai Liusha frowned slightly and looked intently with her beautiful eyes. Through the swirling smoke, a face that made her deeply disgusted immediately appeared in her eyes.
"Is it you?" She was startled for a moment, then an angry look appeared, and she shouted softly: "Why are you here? Who let you in."
Jiang Lai smiled and said hello, "Miss Hai, we meet again."
"You're just in time. Now that you're here, don't leave." With that said, Hai Liusha walked quickly to the desk, picked up the mobile phone on the table, and prepared to call the police. After Jiang Lai left last night, the more she thought about it, the more unwilling she became. She had never been bullied like this before. If she met him again, she would definitely make him look good.
Yun Jiang on the side saw this, his expression remained unchanged and said: "Miss Hai, if I were you, I would never do this. Do you want what happened last night to happen again?"
Hearing this, Hai Liusha's movements couldn't help but froze, and his eyes were filled with shame and anger. This bastard actually dared to threaten himself! Taking a deep breath, she hesitated for a moment, then slowly put down the phone. When she thought about last night's experience, she was indeed a little afraid. If that guy touched her again, she probably even wanted to die.
After calming down, she turned around, looked at Jiang Lai on the sofa, and asked, "Tell me, why did you come to me?"
"Miss Hai, I heard that your recent situation is not good. It seems that someone is trying to harm you."
"What does this have to do with you? Don't you think you're being nosy?"
"If it were before, I wouldn't care about your life or death, but since you and Qing Manrong are twin sisters, I can't let you die. Only if you are alive can I have a chance to find her."
"You're dreaming!" Hai Liusha said coldly: "I will never leave my safety in the hands of someone like you. Also, I'm warning you, don't have any ideas about my sister. If you dare to touch a hair on her head, I will never let you go."
"It's not up to you." Jiang Lai put out the cigarette butt, slowly stood up and walked to Hai Liusha, looked at her flawless face, and said with a smile: "Miss Hai, since you are so protective of your sister and don't want her to be hurt, then you might as well suffer on her behalf."
Sensing his bad intentions, Hai Liusha couldn't help but take a step back, lips and teeth slightly parted and said: "What... do you mean?"
"Your sister is not only my enemy, but also my woman. If you don't want anything to happen to her, then become my woman in her place, serve me, and accept my revenge. Are you willing?"
